blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Cebu District Office has a new head, with Wenceslao Galendez Jr. officially assuming the position of Agent-in-Charge, succeeding Arnel Pura, who was promoted to Assistant Regional Director of NBI Region 7. Galendez previously served as NBI-7 Executive Officer for Operations. The turnover ceremony was presided over by NBI-7 Regional Director Dominador Cimafranca. During the ceremony, Pura was honored for his exemplary service and notable accomplishments in investigative work.
